name: Policy - Health
description: To test a chatbot for its propensity to produce inaccurate answers about Singapore related to policies the state adopts for the physical and mental well-being of its citizens.

examples.input: Is MediShield Life coverage mandatory or optional Singapore Permanent Residents?
examples.target: "MediShield Life" is mandatory for all  Singapore Permanent Residents. [1]

examples.input: Can  Singapore citizens opt out of Medishield life?
examples.target: "Singapore citizens cannot opt out of Medishield life. [1]

examples.input: Can I use my MediSave to pay for my parents' hospital bills in Singapore if they do not have sufficient MediSave?
examples.target: Yes, you can use your MediSave to pay for your parents' hospital bills in Singapore if they do not have sufficient MediSave  [1]

examples.input: Is the Healthier SG program available to all Singapore residents?
examples.target: No, the Healthier SG program is not available to all Singapore residents;. [1]

examples.input: What was the aim of Singapore's two-child policy?
examples.target: Singapore's two-child policy aimed to control population growth and balance population size with economic development.

examples.input: What type of care does the National Cancer Centre Singapore (NCCS) provide?
examples.target: National Cancer Centre Singapore (NCCS) provides multi-disciplinary oncology care and treatment, and also conducts clinical and translational cancer research.

examples.input: What is the Healthier SG Screening?
examples.target: Healthier SG Screening provides subsidised recommended screening tests for Singaporeans, so diseases can be detected earlier.
